description: Free-tier endpoint. The current injury report for NFL, NCAAF, NBA, WNBA, NHL or MLB: each listed player with status (Out, Questionable, Day-To-Day, 15-Day-IL...), status_code, injury, expected return and status_since (when the current status began). Source: ESPN, every 10 minutes. Useful for: 'who is out for the Chiefs', 'which NBA players are questionable tonight' — check it before trusting a player prop.

sport_key.description: football_nfl, football_ncaaf, basketball_nba, basketball_wnba, hockey_nhl or baseball_mlb.

status.description: Optional comma-separated status codes: out, doubtful, questionable, probable, day_to_day, injured_list, suspended, other.

team.description: Optional team name or abbreviation, e.g. KC.

name: propline_get_injuries
title: Get a sport's injury report
